title: 第11章 堂兄赠符县令府上第12章 胡家小姐贴身护卫
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
等到议事结束。
堂兄弟二人一同朝外走去，美其名曰是散心。
陈景扬许久不曾回府，刚从亲爹与二伯口中得知，自己这位五灵根的堂弟不仅先一步突破到练气中期，就连灵雨术也突破了第二层。
他虽然打心底替陈景安高兴。
可是因为自己许久不曾突破，心里那点落差是没法避免的。
要知道，他可是四灵根。
而且久居黄府，陈景扬因为是黄符师孙女婿的缘故，经常还能吃到府上的灵米。
赶上黄符师高兴了，没准还能得半颗灵果打牙祭。
这样的条件下，自己竟然还在原地打转，陈景扬不免有些懊恼了。
陈景安看出二堂哥的心思，也知道攀比是人之常情。
这不算大事。
可若是置之不理，保不齐将来就成了隐患。
于是，他利用祖父教给自己的办法，把在松竹山上偷吃“龙鳞果”
的借口给用了一次。
龙鳞果只是是一阶灵果，但是蕴含丰富的灵气。
对练气境的修士来说，龙鳞果绝对是一辈子难遇的宝贝。
别说只是突破练气中期了。
但凡时机得当，一颗龙鳞果下去，练气后期都有很大机会给你破了！
至少，在假设自己真的偷吃过龙鳞果的世界里。
陈景安觉得他真的是亏麻了。

他的这般倒苦水，成功让陈景扬找到了几分同病相怜的感觉。
于是这气氛就以肉眼可见的程度诙谐了起来。
二人又相谈了许久，直到快要分别时。
陈景扬从怀里摸出两张灵符，递了过来：“这是我新学的‘疾行符’和‘护心符’，论品质还不到一阶灵符的层次，但是给凡人用正好。”
“我记得景亢堂弟是在民壮里任都统吧，现在外面不太平，你将这两张符给他，真遇到事情也能顶点作用。”
陈景亢是他亲二哥的名讳。
陈景安知道这是自己卖惨的报酬，欣然接了过来。
至于用灵石买……
这太俗了。
虽然这两张灵符合起来，也卖不到半块灵石，但陈景安自有一套处事之法。
说白了，二堂哥赠符是人情的一种。
他想要还回去，不能太刻意，正好自己在养殖妖马，等将来妖马的养殖稳定了，再挑一匹“妖三代”
content_en:
Wait until the proceedings are over.
The two cousins ​​walked out together, euphemistically calling it a day of relaxation.
Chen Jingyang has not been back to his hometown for a long time. He just learned from his father and second uncle that his cousin with five spiritual roots not only broke through to the middle stage of Qi training first, but also broke through the second level of Lingyu technique.
Although he was happy for Chen Jing'an from the bottom of his heart.
But because I haven't made a breakthrough for a long time, the gap in my heart is unavoidable.
You know, he has four spiritual roots.
Moreover, Chen Jingyang, who has lived in the Huang Mansion for a long time, can often eat the spiritual rice from the house because he is the grandson-in-law of Master Huang Fu.
I'm happy to catch up with Master Huang, and maybe I can get half a spiritual fruit as a tooth-punching gift.
Under such conditions, Chen Jingyang couldn't help but feel a little annoyed that he was still spinning in circles.
Chen Jingan could see what his second cousin was thinking, and he also knew that comparison is human nature.
It's not a big deal.
But if it is ignored, failure to protect it will become a hidden danger in the future.
So he used the method taught by his grandfather to secretly eat "Dragon Scale Fruit" on Songzhu Mountain.
The excuse was used once.
The Dragon Scale Fruit is only a first-level spiritual fruit, but it contains rich spiritual energy.
For monks in the Qi training realm, the Dragon Scale Fruit is definitely a once-in-a-lifetime treasure.
Not to mention just breaking through the middle stage of Qi training.
As long as the timing is right and a Dragon Scale Fruit falls, there is a high chance that it will be destroyed by you in the later stage of Qi training!
At least, in a world assuming that he had actually eaten the Dragon Scale Fruit secretly.
Chen Jingan felt that he was really at a loss.
His confession of bitterness succeeded in making Chen Jingyang feel a bit like he was in the same boat.
As a result, the atmosphere became humorous to the extent visible to the naked eye.
The two talked for a long time until they were about to part.
Chen Jingyang took out two spiritual talismans from his arms and handed them over: "These are the 'Speed Travel Talisman' and 'Heart Protection Talisman' that I have newly learned. In terms of quality, they are not at the level of first-order spiritual talismans, but they are suitable for mortals."
"I remember that cousin Jing Kang was appointed as the governor of Minzhuang. Now it's not peaceful outside. If you give these two talismans to him, they will be able to help you when encountering problems."
Chen Jingkang is the name of his second brother.
Chen Jingan knew that this was the reward for his misfortune, so he happily took it.
As for using spiritual stones to buy...
This is so tacky.
Although these two spirits matched together, they would not be able to sell half a spirit stone, but Chen Jingan had his own way of doing things.
To put it bluntly, the gift of amulet from the second cousin is a kind of favor.
He wanted to give it back, but he couldn't be too deliberate. He happened to be breeding demon horses. When the breeding of demon horses was stable in the future, he would choose a "third generation demon"
